cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Act Authorized
cards.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Here's the approved room request. Please put our rehearsal on the calendar.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Yes, I process rehearsal approvals. You handle calendar entry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can hold the room while the manager confirms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use 'confirmed'; 'held' generates another approval request. Let's spare her a duplicate.
